summary: A validator check found 125 timeline-event and court-status URLs that were not listed in their records' source lists (events added in earlier runs without a matching source entry). Part 1 of the backfill: the project owner supplied the URL list, researchers opened 65 of the pages, and the record files were completed. 61 source entries were added across 36 records, each describing the opened document (title, publisher, date, kind). Ten of the orphan URLs were on lead-only hosts (an aggregator, three associations, a litigation tracker, an advocacy group's case page and two republishing platforms): nine events were re-sourced to court orders, agency documents or news reports that state the same fact (including the D.C. Circuit's 2026-05-04 order that now carries the c30-02 court status, and the USDA release of 2025-07-24 that settles a date), and one assessment from an association journal was moved to uncertainties as an unverified lead. Six events were narrowed to what their Federal Register pages state (one rule rather than several at State, OFCCP, DOL and EDA; a BIS rule that builds on rather than finalizes an interim rule; an unsettled entity count dropped), one event whose cited page did not show it was removed (c00-01), and c03-01's court status now rests on a reported amended complaint rather than a tracker. An independent review of the text edits produced 26 corrections, all applied. No stage, progress or confidence changed. 60 URLs (68 citations in 37 records) remain to be opened in part 2 once access to them is granted. Counts unchanged at 627.
title: Source-list backfill, part 1, 2026-10-23
